question: Which of the following countries will host the 22ⁿd FIFA World Cup Football in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** FIFA World Cup**

 
 
• The FIFA world cup started in 1930 and is held every four years except in 1942 and 1946 when it was not held due to the Second World War.
 
• The 2022 FIFA World Cup is the 22nd edition of the FIFA World Cup and is scheduled to be held in Qatar.
 
• With the end of every FIFA World Cup, the host of the coming year is announced.
 
• 32 teams will participate in this tournament.
 
• These 32 teams are divided into 8 groups of 4–4 teams.
 
• After qualifying in this stage, 16 teams will reach the knockout stage.
 
• In 2018, it was held in Russia.
